text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this month's Twinkle Monthly is out.
I knew
the Oka Sho feature was gonna
be huge.

text_block_list.name: Local B
text_block_list.text:
But the Satsuki Sho winner was really
something!
...What was her name again?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Jordan! Those nails you uploaded
yesterday
were totally adorbs! Like, I'm
obsessed!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I know, right? You get it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Besties... ♪

text_block_list.name: Jordan and Friends
text_block_list.text: Unite! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that great or what? I'm gonna
upload it
to UmaTok.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan! Did you forget about your
math
lesson?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh... Uh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Run away! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah! ☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That's it! I'll be speaking with your
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What?! Is that really necessary?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, well if it isn't Tosen Jordan. Sup?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ew, no. Hearing you say my full name
just sounds
weird.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha, okay then, Jordan, I—

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my gosh. Is that Jordan... with City?!
That's,
like, the strongest combo ever!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Looks like you've got some
admirers. Keep it
up, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Get it, Jordaaan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm attending some lectures for
trainers
given by special guests on the
outdoor stage.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer
<username>?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's a fellow trainer who joined Tracen
at the
same time as me. We both work
hard to push
each other to be better
trainers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Are you attending "A New Proposal for
Training
Cleats"?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't tell me! You're going to
"Useful
Plyometrics" and "Racing
Patterns and
Competitive Thinking" too?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Great! I am too! Shall we go together?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we could compare notes in
case it's
too difficult to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
How to overtake front runners from their
tells.
Practice predicting movement in
pairs, with one
running in front of the
other... Hm.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek is good as both a pace chaser and
a late
surger, so this training should be
effective for her!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer
<username>! If
it's
okay with you, why don't we try out the

method together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have hoped for a better
suggestion.
Tosen Jordan is also a great
pace chaser and late
surger. This training
certainly won't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'm looking forward
to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tosen Jordan and I team up with
Trainer
Kiryuin and her trainee, Happy
Meek, for a joint
training session.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek. Today, I'd like the two of you to
practice
taking the lead after the third
corner.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
One of you will sit back until the final
corner and
watch for the tells of the
other.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
See whether she moves to the inside or
outside,
how she shifts her weight...
Then, use those tells
to determine how
to best overtake her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. That's, like, next level. Way over
my head.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh! G-good idea. Apologies. Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Trainer. You don't have to
force
yourself to simplify it.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I want to understand what you said... I'll
study the
difficult words too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Meek.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, so did you get what she was saying
back
there? 'Cause for me, it literally
went in one ear
and out the other.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...It was really hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
But my trainer works really hard for my
sake.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I... want to match that. Even though it's
hard, I
have to work hard too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...But like, aren't there times when you
just can't
understand even though you
really want to?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What do you do then?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? Are we doing it now? Or...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhh, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Her ears?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Is it really that simple? Is that what all
that
shifting weight and tells stuff was
about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They begin the exercise, and it's Tosen
Jordan's
turn to pass this time.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
If the front runner makes a front runner
telling
move... It's possible to confuse
the opponent
and... uh?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Her footsteps don't sound any
closer. Is
she... not planning to pass?
Then, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I just make a break for it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Her ears turned this way on the fourth
corner!
That means...)

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
She's making a move! I can't let her...
Huh? Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the fourth corner, Happy Meek pins
her ears
and accelerates, but centrifugal
force drives her
farther and farther to
the outside.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no obstacles left in front of her,
Tosen
Jordan rides the rail straight
through the finish
line!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
Was
that...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's true that the inside tends to open up
if they
sprint on the fourth corner.
Centrifugal force will
push them to the
outside no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And it's true that many Umamusume
instinctively
pin back their ears when
they're about to sprint...
including Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's as simple as can be when you think
about it. I
was so fixated on what we
heard in the lecture
that I forgot a basic
tell like that.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
She passed me, Trainer... Even though
you taught
me what to do...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's not your fault. I should be
apologizing to you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This has been an eye-opening exercise.
Why don't
we go over it when we get
back? There's so much
I'd like to teach
you.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'd like that. I want to understand
what you
were trying to teach me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So our joint training comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're mad smart, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's the problem with you. Learn to
take the
compliment, fam.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, you are super smart. Like, for real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...If only I could understand all your
strategies, maybe
I'd be a stronger
runner.
